CustomField.description: Combines street, city, state, and country into a clean, readable address with proper punctuation. BRME-5775
CustomField.formula: TRIM( IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Address__Street__s)), Address__Street__s, "") & IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Address__Street__s)), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Address__City__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__CountryCode__s))) ) ), ", ", "" ) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Address__City__s)), Address__City__s, "") & IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Address__City__s)), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__CountryCode__s))) ) ), ", ", "" ) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__StateCode__s))), TEXT(Address__StateCode__s), "") & IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__CountryCode__s))) ), ", ", "" ) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__CountryCode__s))), TEXT(Address__CountryCode__s), "") )
CustomField.label: Address Text
